label: MazEF system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a two-component MazEF toxin-antitoxin locus whose MazE antitoxin and MazF endoribonuclease can protect Escherichia coli against RNA phages and that DefenseFinder represents with mandatory MazEF__MazE and MazEF__MazF profiles.
observations: MazEF branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual mazE or mazF genes, MazE or MazF proteins, MazF ACA-cleavage sites, cellular RNA degradation, generic toxin-antitoxin systems, unresolved MazEF activation routes, RNA phage genomes escaping MazF cleavage, source database rows naming one MazEF model, and other phage-defense systems.
